tokens.name: flare
tokens.usage: The brand signal, from --color-flare in globals.css. Fills only: primary button, logo disc, current pipeline step. Pair with on-flare text. Never text. On light surface-0 it is 2.99:1, so a flare mark that carries meaning always sits beside a word.

tokens.name: flare-strong
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of flare. Light value also serves as the focus ring.

tokens.name: flare-text
tokens.usage: Orange text and citation numbers on surface-0, surface-1 and surface-2 (4.5:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: flare-wash
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind the selected row or the current pipeline step. Text on it: ink.

tokens.name: on-flare
tokens.usage: Text and icons on flare and flare-strong fills.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring, offset 2px, on every interactive element. 3:1 on all surfaces.

tokens.name: surface-0
tokens.usage: Page background. Dark value is neutral-950 from globals.css.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Raised: cards, panels, inputs, secondary buttons.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Hover rows, badge grounds, code and data wells.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card borders. Decorative: no contrast floor.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that mark a control (inputs, secondary buttons). 3:1 on surface-0 and surface-1.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on every surface and on flare-wash. Dark value is neutral-100 from globals.css.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, source domains, on every surface. Dark value is neutral-400 from page.tsx.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholders and not-yet-reached pipeline steps, on surface-0 and surface-1 (4.5:1).

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Verified email, approved outreach. Text on surface-0/1/2; always with a word.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Pattern-guessed email, sent outreach. Text on surface-0/1/2; always with a word.

tokens.name: caution
tokens.usage: Awaiting human approval, risky email. Text on surface-0/1/2; always with a word.

tokens.name: negative
tokens.usage: Bounced email, rejected draft, errors. Pink-red, kept apart from flare by hue and a word. Text on surface-0/1/2.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: One per page at most: marketing and empty-state heroes.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Page title. Matches the h1 in page.tsx (text-4xl serif).

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Card and panel titles, lead names.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Describe your product in plain language. Flare infers who buys it.
styles.usage: Running text. Keep lines near 65 characters.

styles.name: cell
styles.usage: Text in data grid cells (operating register). Numbers in cells use data.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows and section labels, set uppercase. Matches page.tsx (xs, tracking-widest).

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Scores, counts, credits, IDs. Tabular numerals.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to text, number to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips and badges; between inline controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between lines of a card; small-button padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; button padding; minimum page gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between cards; page side padding (px-6 in page.tsx).

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between groups inside a section.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Page top and bottom padding (py-16 in page.tsx).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Citation chips, inputs' inner elements.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and panels.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status badges and the signal disc.

shadow.note: Borders separate surfaces; shadows only lift overlays.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, dialogs. Nothing that sits in the page flow.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of reading pages (max-w-3xl in page.tsx).

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Height of buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Height of small buttons and table actions.

tokens.name: grid-head
tokens.usage: Height of data grid header rows.

tokens.name: grid-row
tokens.usage: Height of data grid body rows (default density).

tokens.name: grid-row-compact
tokens.usage: Height of body rows with fl-grid--compact, for 50+ rows.

tokens.name: feed-width
tokens.usage: Width of the Agent thinking panel beside the grid at 1200px and wider.
